summary: The core corrected hierarchy is mostly right in the detailed tables and in `scripts/AD_full_hierarchy_KD_ER_logneg.py`, but the Round 3 patch does not fully propagate those fixes through the surrounding summary docs. In particular, `gap_analysis` still treats degradable AD as if true `K^{↔}` were known from the degradable formula, and `PHASE1_REPORT` / `PHASE_STATUS` still contain stale six-state and `AD K_D` summaries. There are also remaining top-level labels/headings that reintroduce the old `Q` vs `K^{↔}` confusion. Because these are prominent mathematical summaries, I would not mark this round PASS yet.

issues.description: The §3.3 attribution table still says degradable AD has `A ~0`, `B ~0`, `紧界已知`, with evidence `E_R^PPT/K_D ≤ 1.52`. That contradicts the corrected statements elsewhere in the same file (`Q ≤ K^{↔} ≤ E_R^PPT`, `K^{↔}` unknown). This reintroduces the Round-1 error at the summary layer by treating the degradable formula as true two-way key capacity rather than only a lower bound.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the AD degradable row to reference `Q`, not `K_D`, and weaken the conclusion accordingly, e.g. 'A small relative to Q; true K^{↔} still unknown' or equivalent language consistent with §2.1/§4.3.

issues.description: The high-level report/status docs still contain stale math claims. `PHASE1_REPORT.md` still says the six-state SP formula is '接近紧 (B 原因小)' after the detailed findings were corrected to a 3-6× per-signal gap. `PHASE_STATUS.md` still labels the AD formula as `AD K_D = Q`, claims `log_neg ≥ E_R ≥ K_D` was numerically verified over 4 channels, and still lists `gap_shape_g4_1.md v0.3` with candidate D = AD K_D analytic. These summaries contradict the corrected Round-3 conclusions and will mislead readers who skim status docs rather than the detailed findings.
issues.suggestion: Propagate the final terminology/results into both summary docs: rename the AD quantity to `Q`, remove claims that the 4-channel verification established `K_D` for AD, update the gap-shape status to v0.4/reference-quantity wording, and replace the six-state 'near tight' summary with the corrected per-signal 3-6× characterization.

issues.description: Prominent headings still encode the old hierarchy incorrectly. `upper_bound_report.md` section 11 is titled 'AD K_D 解析', and the §11.2 table column is '真 K_D / E_R', even though the AD row now only gives degradable `Q`. Separately, the title of `qubit_E_R_PPT_hierarchy_2026-04-23.md` says `log_neg ≥ E_R^PPT ≥ E_R (≥ Q ≤ K^{↔})`, which is not the correct general relation and is malformed relative to the intended `Q ≤ K^{↔} ≤ E_R (= E_R^PPT on 2⊗2) ≤ log_neg`. Even if the body text is mostly corrected, these top-level labels still misstate the math at skim level.
issues.suggestion: Rename the section/column labels to explicitly distinguish `Q` from true `K^{↔}` and restate the title hierarchy in a mathematically valid form, e.g. `log_neg ≥ E_R^PPT = E_R ≥ K^{↔} ≥ Q` for the 2⊗2 cases discussed, with the AD caveat that only `Q` is known analytically.

round_recommendation: Fix the remaining stale summary/headline claims in `gap_analysis`, `PHASE1_REPORT`, `PHASE_STATUS`, and the two findings doc titles/section labels, then re-run a consistency sweep for `Q`, `K^{↔}`, and six-state per-signal wording before the next review.
